entries.zh: 往往（每每、屡次）；西语注「siempre」恒常，另附难解拉丁式短语 et sic debinguli
entries.en: often, again and again (reduplicated form); Sp. gloss 'siempre': always, constantly
entries.notes: 西语栏含难解短语 et sic debinguli，siempre（恒常）与「往（往往，屡次）」义近而不全合，据汉字与对音定释义

entries.zh: 一了（一次了结、就此定局）；对音旁注西语 siempre，17 世纪马尼拉西语中亦作应答语「当然是、一定的」
entries.en: once and for all; done and settled, also used as an emphatic affirmative (Sp. siempre: of course, certainly)

entries.zh: 疑为「素素（年）」一类：素来、平素；「年」字系右缘旁注，整词义不明
entries.en: unclear compound, probably built on su 'plainly, ordinarily' with a marginal 'year'; sense undetermined
entries.notes: 对音 sou sou ni 三音节与汉字栏（素、二年）不对应，西语栏空缺，语义无法定夺

entries.en: the whole face; all over one's face

entries.zh: 终久（终究到底、永久不变）；西语注「siempre, inmutablemente 恒常不变」
entries.en: in the end, ultimately; forever and unchangeably (Sp. siempre, inmutablemente)

entries.zh: 终然（始终到底，直到完结）；西语注「恒常，直到完结」
entries.en: to the very end, until it is finished; always
entries.notes: 西语栏缩写 s.d.（疑即 se dice）依赖推断，故降中置信

entries.zh: 鬓（鬓角、额角两侧发际）；西语 sien 即太阳穴、额角
entries.en: temple(s) of the head, sideburns; the side of the forehead (Sp. sien)
entries.notes: 西语为缩写 Siene~（sien 额角），右缘旁注 plieng 义未明，疑为「边」之音注

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑指鬓角末端一类（「鬢尾、邊坯」？）；仅西语圈注 Siene~ 与对音 pin py 残存
entries.en: illegible head character; possibly 'tip/end of the temple hair' (cf. Sp. sien, circled)
entries.notes: 汉字栏空缺、闽南栏仅存疑字且有污损，仅据西语 Siene~ 与对音 pin py 推断

entries.zh: 麒麟／蛟（此条并列两个神异动物名：麒麟 quy lin、蛟 cau；西语注「怪物般的巨蛇」，末词 nodriua 难解）
entries.en: qilin (fabulous unicorn-like beast) and jiao (flood-dragon serpent); Sp. gloss 'monstrous serpent', final word obscure
entries.notes: 汉字栏空缺、闽南栏两字均存疑，释义据对音 quy lin（麒麟）、cau（蛟）与西语 sierpe monstruosa 推定

entries.zh: 疑为「峻岭」一类：高山峻岭；西语注「高山与山岳」
entries.en: lofty mountain range, high peaks (Sp. 'alta sierra and monte')
entries.notes: 闽南栏「崑」与对音 chin nia（疑即「峻嶺」）不完全对应，据西语 Sierra alta y monte 与「峻」字定释义

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕闽南栏单字「崑」，疑即崑崙之崑，高山义；对音 cun，西语圈注「高山」
entries.en: illegible head character; kun, lofty mountain (as in Kunlun); Sp. gloss 'high sierra' (circled)
entries.notes: 汉字栏空缺且对音旁注污损，仅据闽南栏「崑」与对音 cun 推断

entries.zh: 山（山岳；对音栏并列 san、oa 两读）
entries.en: mountain, hill (two readings recorded: san, oa)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑为「坡」一类：山坡、近海坡地；闽南栏作「波」（po），与西语「近海山岭」不合
entries.en: illegible head character; probably 'slope, hillside' (po); Sp. gloss 'sierra near the sea'
entries.notes: 汉字栏空缺，「波(po)」与西语 Sierra cerca del mar 义不相合，疑「波」为「坡」之讹或另有所指

entries.zh: 嵯峨（山势高峻嶙峋）；西语注「多洞穴之山岭」，llana 或为 llena（满布）之讹
entries.en: rugged and towering, of mountains; Sp. gloss 'sierra with caverns'
entries.notes: 汉字栏空缺，西语 llana de cavernas 与「嵯峨（高峻）」义不甚相合，释义以闽南栏「嵯峨」及对音 cho go 为准

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕闽南栏单字「峨」，对音 so 与其常音不合、疑有讹；西语圈注同前条「多穴之岭」
entries.en: illegible head character; single char e 'lofty' with recorded reading 'so' of uncertain fit; Sp. gloss as the previous entry
entries.notes: 汉字栏空缺，对音 so 与「峨」之常音不对应，仅有闽南栏孤字与重复的西语圈注

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕岳（高山、山岳之尊称，如五岳）；对音 sag 与其常音不合，西语注「琥珀门徒栖居之山」其义不详
entries.en: illegible head character; yue, lofty peak or sacred mountain (as the Five Peaks); Sp. gloss 'sierra where the disciples of amber dwell' (obscure)
entries.notes: 汉字栏空缺，对音 sag 与「岳」之常音不合，西语 gloss 奇特难解
